# CODERZWEB

> High-performance web development, custom Next.js web application engineering, e-commerce architectures, and performance marketing agency based in Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu, serving businesses across South India and pan-India.

CODERZWEB builds enterprise-grade digital systems engineered for speed, search dominance, and measurable revenue growth. We combine modern front-end web architecture (Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS) with data-driven performance marketing (Meta Ads, Google Ads) and AI-powered CRM automation (Official WhatsApp Business API).

## Core Services

- [Custom Web Development](https://coderzweb.in/#services): High-performance Next.js and React responsive websites built for 40% faster load speed, SEO dominance, and lead conversion.
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://coderzweb.in/#services): Full-stack online stores with Razorpay, UPI, and card gateways, automated inventory syncing, and mobile-first UX.
- [Performance Marketing](https://coderzweb.in/#services): ROI-driven Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns for local and pan-India customer acquisition.
- [WhatsApp Business API](https://coderzweb.in/#services): Official WhatsApp CRM integration for automated instant inquiry follow-ups and broadcast marketing.
- [UI/UX & Logo Design](https://coderzweb.in/#services): Brand identity creation, custom vector logos, color palettes, and modern design systems.
- [Video Production & Reels](https://coderzweb.in/#services): High-converting commercial video production, social media ad creatives, and promotional reels.
